# Copilot instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md): it describes the architecture, where to change what, the
definition of done (gofmt, vet, staticcheck, race tests, html-validate, axe-core) and the
project conventions (community-neutral open source, strict CSP, all UI strings in seven
languages, technical English). Frontend specifics: [web/AGENTS.md](../web/AGENTS.md). Design
rationale: [docs/decisions.md](../docs/decisions.md).
